adapters.discrete: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti, Vulkan, driver 615.78.08, USB4 enclosure, PCIe gen 4 x2 (step A transfer-rates files)
adapters.integrated: AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics (RADV STRIX_HALO), Vulkan, Mesa 26.2.4

method: tools/benchmark_gpu2d.py playback --no-sampler (48 frames, first lap, uncached, 1080p) driven by pb1026d.sh: one pass per call, rows interleaved before/after/cpu, three rounds; every pass took /tmp/nb-gpu.lock and ran with no integrator suite (load-log-1026d.txt, other_suites=0); the stand-in is taskset -c 0-3 with QT_SCALE_FACTOR=2; --island-adapter default is the island on the discrete card (Automatic before this step), --island-adapter automatic opens as the app does; the measurement kept in a file (NODEBASED_ISLAND_PROBE_FILE) so the machine's preferences stay untouched
read_lookup_rows: batch-d2: --force-adapter integrated, --stages, NODEBASED_READ_LOOKUP=0 against the default, three interleaved rounds
